note: Complete: all 116 IMSLP pages judged. Recordings were found through MusicBrainz release and track lists, Europadisc, MusicWeb, Challenge Records, Apple Classical and library catalogues; Apple's search API stayed blocked (403), and Naxos Music Library and Presto were not reachable. ONSLOW: 17 of 36 quartets and 21 of 34 quintets are on commercial discs (Mandelring/CPO, Ruggieri, Diotima, Coull/ASV, Charlin; Elan Quintet and Telos/Naxos, Tamuz/Challenge, Charis/SWR, Sony, MDG, CPO); the other 19 quartets and 13 quintets are skipped as not performed or recorded, and may pass if later discs appear. A search-engine snippet of the BnF catalogue mentions an Arion CD (2005) of Quintets Nos. 7-8 (Op. 23-24) and one of Op. 51 (2007); I could not open it, so Nos. 7-8 stay out until someone confirms it. Keys follow the recordings and French Wikipedia where IMSLP is blank or wrong (Op. 44 is C major although CPO prints C minor; Op. 59 D major per Naxos and MusicWeb against D minor in French Wikipedia; Op. 76 G major). MusicBrainz mislabels some tracks (Ruggieri's Aparté disc, the Mandelring "op. 40 no. 2" for Op. 46 No. 2); I checked them against the Aparté track list and Europadisc. IMSLP's pages for Op. 3 Nos. 1-2 are redirects to the collection page, which is therefore their imslpPage. Op. 77b (sextet version of the Nonet) has an IMSLP page the census missed (gap find). Op. 76 is kept as a quintet with its own opus number and two recordings, although French Wikipedia calls it an arrangement of Symphony No. 4 (the owner may rule on arrangements). Onslow's quintets are Onslow's usual two-cello or cello-and-bass scoring; alternatives follow IMSLP's instrumentation field. GAP FINDS for Gade: Piano Trio in B-flat (1839, one movement), String Quartets in F minor (1851) and E minor (1877, rev. 1889), the A-minor quartet movement (1836) and a Scherzo for piano quartet; their level and year are estimates. Not added: Berwald's Serenade for tenor and chamber ensemble (1825; Naxos 8.553714, MDG 903 2189-6) because its scoring is not stated on the pages I opened; Berwald's piano-trio fragments (Naxos 8.555002); Gade's Allegro vivace in E-flat major (Kontrapunkt 32127, scoring unknown); Gade's Novelletten Opp. 53 and 58 (string orchestra); Berwald's Quartet for piano, clarinet, horn and bassoon and Onslow's Wind Quintet Op. 81 have no string part. RECHECK 2026-10-17: 7 works added (Onslow: String Quartet No. 23, Op. 48 [Quatuor Debussy, Auvidis 1995, naive 2017; key A major from the fr.wikipedia work table, the track titles omit it, so medium]; String Quintets Nos. 5, 7, 8, 12, 13 and 34, Op. 18 [Oxford String Quartet, CarltonClassics 1998], Op. 23 and 24 [Le Salon Romantique, Pierre Verany/Arion 2005, the disc the BnF snippet pointed to], Op. 34 and 35 [Quintett Momento Musicale, MDG 2004], Op. 82 [Le Salon Romantique, Pierre Verany/Arion 2007, coupled with Op. 51]); 25 lines settled as not performed or recorded (Onslow: 18 quartets, 7 quintets), after Apple composerTerm sweeps over six name forms and four storefronts, per-work Apple and Deezer searches and MusicBrainz, with no failed lookup; weak negatives all the same, because Apple stops at 200 hits a query and older LPs (such as the Parrenin/Carl de Nys recordings of the 1970s-80s that fr.wikipedia mentions) may not be on the services; 1 still not checked (Gade's Allegro vivace in E-flat major: scoring not found); Berwald and Gade had no 'not performed or recorded' line; Berwald's Serenade for tenor looks like tenor and six winds (sv.wikipedia), so it has no string part and stays out. Hand edits: added the 7 works and removed their 7 skipped lines; rewrote the evidence of the other 25 skipped lines; corrected '(2019)' to '(2004)' in floor.recorded of Op. 33 and Op. 74 (Apple lists the MDG disc 'Onslow: String Quintets, Op. 33 & 74' as copyright 2004 and Deezer dates it 2004-01-01); updated the Onslow, Berwald and Gade lines of composers_checked.
